{{small|([[Chairman]] & [[Managing Director|MD]])}} | revenue = {{decrease}}{{INRConvert|5585.77|c}} (2018)[https://www.bseindia.com/bseplus/AnnualReport/532693/5326930318.pdf "Financial Results 31.03.2018"]. | operating_income = {{decrease}}{{INRConvert|-186.01|c}} (2018) | net_income = {{increase}}{{INRConvert|-71.82|c}} (2018) | assets = {{decrease}}{{INRConvert|11180.52|c}} (2018) | equity = {{decrease}}{{INRConvert|-2026.78|c}} (2018) | owner = | num_employees = 7,359 (March 2018) | products = | website = {{URL|http://www.punjlloyd.com/}} }} '''Punj Lloyd Limited''' was an Indian [[Engineering, procurement and construction]] (EPC) company providing services for energy, infrastructure and defense sectors. The company's operations are spread across the Middle East and Africa,{{cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/construction/punj-lloyd-seeks-to-recover-rs-1300-crore-from-libya/articleshow/62433555.cms?from=mdr|title=Punj Lloyd seeks to recover Rs 1,300 crore from Libya|first=Saikat|last=Das|date=11 January 2018|publisher=|newspaper=The Economic Times}}{{Cite web |url=http://tradearabia.com/touch/article/IT/333527 |title=Archived copy |access-date=25 October 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181025190100/http://tradearabia.com/touch/article/IT/333527 |archive-date=25 October 2018 |url-status=dead |df=dmy-all }} Asia Pacific, South Asia and Europe. The group includes over 50 subsidiaries and has executed many projects in more than 60 countries.{{Cite news |date=2011-04-11 |title=Punj Lloyd's subsidiary to buy stake in Indonesian coal mine |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/companies/Punj-Lloydrsquos-subsidiary-to-buy-stake-in-Indonesian-coal-mine/article14679627.ece |access-date=2024-03-14 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}} The company is headquartered in [[Gurgaon]], [[Haryana]] and its stocks were listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE) and [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] (NSE), until it went into liquidationhttps://www.businesstoday.in/latest/corporate/story/icici-bank-drags-punj-lloyd-nclt-insolvency-non-payment-rs-825-crore-loan-148696-2018-06-14#:~:text=44%20PM%20IST-,Private%20lender%20ICICI%20Bank%20has%20dragged%20infrastructure%20major%20Punj%20Lloyd,which%20led%20to%20the%20development. ==History== The foundation of the company was laid by its chairman Atul Punj in 1982 when he started the pipeline division of his family business, Punj Sons Private Limited. He later incorporated it into Punj Lloyd Engineering private limited. The company was rechristened to its current name in 1989. extract: Punj Lloyd Limited was an Indian Engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) company providing services for energy, infrastructure and defense sectors. The company's operations are spread across the Middle East and Africa, Asia Pacific, South Asia and Europe. The group includes over 50 subsidiaries and has executed many projects in more than 60 countries. The company is headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana and its stocks were listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) and National Stock Exchange (NSE), until it went into liquidation
